card.text: A star 16% of the Sun's width that turns once in 11.8 hours, with a mapped magnetic field.

introduction.text: Morin et al. give it 0.16 solar radii, 0.14 solar masses, a rotation period of 11.8 hours and an axis tilted 60° from the line of sight.
